scene.title: Electric field of opposite charges
scene.summary: Visualize electric field vectors radiating outward from a positive charge and inward toward a negative charge, and see the combined direction at the midpoint.

beats.title: Two point charges
beats.narration: A positive charge (+) sits on the left and a negative charge (–) on the right.

beats.title: Field from positive
beats.narration: Field vectors radiate outward from the positive charge.

beats.title: Field toward negative
beats.narration: Field vectors point inward toward the negative charge.

beats.title: Midpoint field
beats.narration: The combined field at the centre points right, from the positive toward the negative charge.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: Electric field lines start on positive charges and end on negative ones; between opposite charges they point from + to –.
